svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 80 mm lengths of 40 x 40 x 3 angle; square and deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (goes on the saddle web): two 6.6 mm holes, 22.5 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside corner of the angle, 15 and 65 up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg (grips the arm): two 6.6 mm holes at mid-height (40 up),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 and 32 out from the outside face of the flat leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left and right cheeks are mirror images: clamp the upright legs back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to back and drill them together so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat leg flat on the web front, the arm between the two upright

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: legs. M6 button-head screws from inside the saddle hold the flat leg;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M6 bolts pass through both cheeks and the arm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the arm between them both upright legs touch the arm.
